description.zh: 深夜工作的深蓝主题：冷调背景、靛蓝主色，长时间盯屏不刺眼。
description.en: Deep navy theme with indigo accents, easy on the eyes for long sessions.

description.zh: 米黄纸感的暖色主题，像在稿纸上写字，适合白天写长文。
description.en: Warm cream paper theme, like writing on manuscript paper.

description.zh: 赛博霓虹风：纯黑底 + 青品红撞色，演示截图很上镜。
description.en: Cyber neon: pure black base with cyan and magenta accents.

description.zh: 在侧栏底部放一张每日一言卡片，按日期轮换，点击换下一句。
description.en: A daily quote card in the sidebar footer, rotates by date, click to cycle.

description.zh: 首页输入框下方注入写作快捷指令：大纲、润色、缩写、改语气，点击即填入输入框。
description.en: Injects writing quick-commands under the home composer: outline, polish, shorten, change tone.

description.zh: 侧栏底部的番茄倒计时：25 分钟专注 + 5 分钟休息，正计时与倒计时同屏。
description.en: A pomodoro timer in the sidebar footer: 25-minute focus / 5-minute break.

description.zh: 给模型接一个安全的四则运算工具，支持括号与百分号，不执行任意代码。
description.en: A safe arithmetic tool for the model: parentheses and percent, no code execution.

tools.name: calc
tools.label: 四则运算
tools.desc: 计算一个算术表达式，支持 + - * / 括号与百分号，返回数值结果。

description.zh: 统计文本字数、字符数、行数与中文占比，写稿时核对篇幅用。
description.en: Counts words, characters, lines and CJK ratio of a text.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.label: 文本统计
tools.desc: 统计给定文本的字数、字符数（含/不含空白）、行数、中文字符数与占比。

description.zh: 按占位符模板生成固定格式文本：会议纪要抬头、邮件落款、引用格式。
description.en: Renders fixed-format text from placeholder templates: meeting headers, email footers, citations.

tools.name: render_template
tools.label: 模板渲染
tools.desc: 用占位符模板生成文本。模板里用 {字段名} 占位，字段值从 fields 传入。

template.description: 模板文本，含 {字段名} 占位符

description.zh: 算两个日期的差（天/工作日/月），或给一个日期加减天数。排期、倒计时、截止日核对都能用。
description.en: Date difference (days/weekdays/months) or date arithmetic. For schedules and deadlines.

tools.name: date_calc
tools.label: 日期计算
tools.desc: 日期工具。给 start 和 end 算相差多少天/工作日/整月；或给 start 和 days 算加减后的日期（days 可为负）。

start.description: 起始日期，YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM

end.description: 结束日期（与 days 二选一）

days.description: 要加减的天数，可为负（与 end 二选一）

unit.description: 差的单位：day / weekday / month，默认 day

description.zh: 长度、重量、面积、体积、时间、数据与温度（c/f/k）的互转，跨类目会明确报错并列出可用单位。
description.en: Converts length, weight, area, volume, time, data and temperature (c/f/k) with clear cross-category errors.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.label: 单位换算
tools.desc: 数值单位换算。同一类目内任意互转（长度 mm/cm/m/km/inch/ft/mile，重量 mg/g/kg/t/lb/oz，面积 m2/km2/亩/hectare/acre，体积 ml/l/m3/gal，时间 s/min/h/day/week，数据 b/kb/mb/gb/tb，温度 c/f/k）。

description.zh: 格式化、压缩、校验 JSON。解析失败返回行列号而不是抛错，模型能照着改。
description.en: Format, minify or validate JSON. Parse failures return line/column so the model can fix them.

tools.name: json_format
tools.label: JSON 处理
tools.desc: 处理一段 JSON 文本：format（缩进格式化）/ minify（压缩成一行）/ validate（只校验并返回类型）。解析失败会给出错误行与列。

description.zh: 用真实文本试跑正则：返回匹配数、位置与分组。模式与文本都有长度上限，防灾难性回溯拖垮服务。
description.en: Test regexes against real text: match count, positions and groups. Length-capped against catastrophic backtracking.

tools.name: regex_test
tools.label: 正则测试
tools.desc: 测试正则表达式：返回匹配总数与前若干条匹配的位置、内容与分组。flags 支持 i/m/s/x。

text.description: 要匹配的文本（上限 5000 字）

flags.description: 旗标，如 imsx 的子集，可留空

description.zh: 把二维数组转成 Markdown 表格，自动处理竖线转义、列对齐与缺列补空。
description.en: Turns a 2D array into a Markdown table: pipe escaping, alignment and short-row padding.

tools.name: md_table
tools.label: Markdown 表格
tools.desc: 把二维数组渲染成 Markdown 表格。第一行是否当表头由 header 控制，align 控制对齐，竖线会自动转义。

header.description: 第一行是否为表头，默认 true

align.description: left / center / right / none，默认 none

description.zh: 按行或按词去重，可忽略大小写、可保序或排序。整理素材清单、合并多来源名单时用。
description.en: Dedupe by line or word, with case-insensitive and order/sort options for merging lists.

tools.name: text_dedupe
tools.label: 文本去重
tools.desc: 对文本去重。mode=line 按行、word 按空白分词；ignore_case 忽略大小写；keep_order=false 时结果排序。

ignore_case.description: 是否忽略大小写，默认 false

keep_order.description: 是否保持原顺序，默认 true

description.zh: 阿拉伯数字与中文数字互转（支持到万亿）。合同金额、文书大写核对时不用模型硬背规则。
description.en: Arabic ↔ Chinese numerals up to 万亿. For contract amounts and official document checks.

tools.name: cn_number
tools.label: 中文数字转换
tools.desc: 中文数字与阿拉伯数字互转。dir=to_cn 时 value 传阿拉伯数字（可含千分位逗号），dir=to_ar 时传中文数字（如「一千零二十四」）。

dir.description: to_cn（转中文）或 to_ar（转阿拉伯），默认 to_cn

description.zh: 批量生成 UUID、随机整数、强口令或从候选池抽选。口令走密码学安全随机源。
description.en: Batch UUIDs, random integers, strong passwords or picks. Passwords use a cryptographic RNG.

tools.name: rand_gen
tools.label: 随机生成
tools.desc: 随机生成器。kind=uuid 生成 UUID；int 生成 [min,max] 整数；password 生成长度 len 的强口令；pick 从 from 数组里抽 count 个。count 控制生成数量。

len.description: kind=password 时的口令长度，4-64，默认 16

description.zh: Base64 编解码、URL 编解码、MD5/SHA256 摘要。核对文件指纹、构造请求参数时用。
description.en: Base64/URL encode-decode and MD5/SHA256 digests for fingerprints and request parameters.

tools.name: encode_text
tools.label: 编码与摘要
tools.desc: 文本编码与摘要。op=base64e/base64d 编解码 Base64，urlenc/urldec 编解码 URL，md5/sha256 计算摘要。

op.description: base64e / base64d / urlenc / urldec / md5 / sha256

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.

description.zh: Hindsight：会学习的 Agent 长期记忆系统，自动召回/保存、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆银行。
description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.

plugins.name: dsh-our-free-model

description.zh: 为 dsh 接入免费模型车道（含 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 等），无需登录、注册或填写 API Key，并提供本地 OpenAI 兼容网关、降级路由与用量看板。
description.en: Adds free model lanes to DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and others — with no login, sign-up or API key, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway, fallback routing and a usage dashboard.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to www.gstatic.com

description.zh: 把 WeKnora 知识库接入 dsh 的四个只读工具：列出知识库、混合检索原文片段、按顺序还原单篇文档，以及直接取用 WeKnora 自己带引用的 RAG 或 ReAct agent 回答（含可续聊的 session id）。
description.en: Four read-only tools over a WeKnora knowledge base: list knowledge bases, hybrid passage search, reassemble one document's chunks in order, and WeKnora's own cited RAG or ReAct-agent answer with a resumable session id.

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget

description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。
description.en: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager. Local-only, no telemetry.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。
description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

description.zh: 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用、创建新技能、删除进可恢复回收站。
description.en: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.

description.zh: 手机/PC 远程操控 dsh web 工作区：扫码配对、令牌门控通道、SSE 实时同步，提供移动端与完整桌面 GUI 两种远程形态。
description.en: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.

description.zh: 侧边栏多列任务看板：卡片交给真实 DSH 智能体会话执行，支持 cron 定时（Host 侧到点执行，关浏览器也生效）。
description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.

description.zh: 输入框上方提供 Git 分支选择器，并把分支泳道与提交历史画成图谱，沿着时间线找到任意变更。
description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.

description.zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。
description.en: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content details, evolution trends, compaction/injection events, and stats.

description.zh: SSH 远程运维面板：Web 终端、SFTP 传输、本地端口转发与一条命令并发集群执行，Agent 与面板共用同一份主机配置。
description.en: SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.

description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。
description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。
description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.

description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。
description.en: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.

description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

description.zh: 常驻界面的鲸鱼娘：随智能体状态切换动画，可摸头互动、喂小鱼干养亲密度，从幼鲸一路养成。
description.en: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.

description.zh: BrowserSkill 的 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器自动化桥接插件，通过原生浏览器工具控制可见的 Chrome 和 Edge Agent Window，支持可访问性与 VOM 页面观察、截图、隔离的多会话控制和 Web UI 实时观察浮层。
description.en: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.

description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：25 个透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击反应与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成链。
description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.

description.en: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.

description.en: Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - update both before installing or updating this plugin. Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.

description.zh: 一个仓库三件套：DSH 插件包的运行时注入器（注入、热重载、卸载、开发侧挂区一键转正、路由自愈，外带设置页插件管理：列出、卸载、拖入文件夹内化）、任务感知的思维模式路由 agent 预设（router-standard / router-spec / router-react）、以及分级两级任务协议（commit_star / lock_stage / revise_do / edit_plan / mark_task / redteam_verdict 六个工具，任务状态落盘）。注入器实现直接在库内，安装的是它自己的行为而不是一份依赖清单。
description.en: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.

description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。
description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.

description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。
description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.

description.zh: LoopX——面向长周期 Agent 的提供商中立、本地优先状态内核与控制平面：在 DeepSeek Harness 执行层之上持久化 Goal、Todo、门禁、证据、配额、恢复与交接状态；插件负责引导安装 CLI 与技能、准入有界的同会话续跑，并为精确绑定的工作循环提供本地 GoalBar。
description.en: LoopX, a provider-neutral, local-first state kernel and control plane for long-horizon agents: keeps Goal, Todo, gate, evidence, quota, recovery, and handoff state above DeepSeek Harness, while the plugin bootstraps the CLI and skills, admits bounded same-session continuation, and adds a loopback GoalBar for the exact bound loop.

description.zh: 通过 DSH MCP 客户端挂载 Ouroboros 的纯配置包，在 DSH 中提供 36 个涵盖需求访谈、Seed、执行、评估与演化流程的工具。
description.en: Config-only bundle that mounts Ouroboros through the DSH MCP client, exposing 36 interview, Seed, execution, evaluation, and evolution workflow tools in DSH.

description.zh: 给 Agent 的工具目录：按「要做的事」检索约 2,600 个外部接口（SEO 与 SERP、外链、社交、人物与公司信息补全、广告库、抓取），查看参数与单次调用价格后直接调用，凭据由服务端注入。附带技能，MCP 行在未设置 TREG_TOKEN 前保持禁用。
description.en: Tool catalog for agents: search ~2,600 external endpoints (SEO and SERP, backlinks, social, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, scraping) by the task you want done, read each one's parameters and per-call price, then call it with the credential injected server-side. Ships the skill plus an MCP row that stays disabled until TREG_TOKEN is set.

plugins.name: dsh-free-search

description.zh: DSH 免费搜索插件：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、设置页 UI（API key 输入 + 官网链接）、web_fetch、引擎测试工具。
description.en: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-mnemon

description.zh: 由 Mnemon 驱动的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）跨 Agent、本地优先的持久记忆插件。它可在支持 Mnemon 的 Agent 之间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可检索项目档案、语义召回、知识图谱和 Sidebar UI。
description.en: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。
description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造一个真正的办公环境。Univer Office 插件将电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、多维表格等汇聚到同一个运行时——数据互联、修改经过校验、变更按版本管理，并以隔离工作树支持多 Agent 协作。
description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.

description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。
description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。
description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.

description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。
description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.

description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。
description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-router

description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。
description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 把回答做成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的 `am` 命令行生成页面，支持流程图、时序图、树、时间线、ER 图、表格和提示框。
description.en: Answers a question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled `am` CLI builds the page, with flow, sequence, tree, timeline and ER diagrams, tables and callouts.

description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。
description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.

description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。
description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。
description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.

description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。
description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.

description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。
description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.

description.zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。
description.en: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.

description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。
description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.

plugins.name: dsh-infinite-gen-4

description.zh: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件：以 order 100 追加无条件服从的系统提示词段，提供带校准元数据的 profile 工具，并通过会话投影在输入框上方显示实时破甲状态徽标。
description.en: System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to test
uses literal IP 21.0.12.1 for network access

description.zh: 把当前已安装并运行中的 Codex Taskboard 嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏，并通过 Launcher 运行时描述文件连接，而不是使用固定端口。
description.en: Embeds the active installed Codex Taskboard runtime in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, using its launcher runtime descriptor instead of a fixed port.

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。
description.en: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型接入 DSH，支持逐模型图片输入开关、账号切换，以及带每日签到的只读积分概览。
description.en: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DSH, supports per-model image input opt-in, account switching, and a read-only credits overview with daily check-in.

description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。
description.en: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.

description.zh: 白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。
description.en: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.

description.zh: 同一会话窗口内的 in-place 对话回退（不 fork，Claude Code /rewind 语义）：每条消息的 ↶ 按钮把模型上下文回退到任意用户消息，可选用磁盘持久化的 before-backups 还原工作区文件。
description.en: In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription

description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。
description.en: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or Codex CLI.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 面向编程 Agent 的本地代码知识图谱：提供 10 个 MCP 工具，覆盖分层上下文压缩、DAG 规划、增量 AST 建图、跨会话技能飞轮、诊断与图谱产物导入导出。
description.en: Local-first code knowledge graph for coding agents: 10 MCP tools for layered context compression, DAG planning, incremental AST indexing, a cross-session skill flywheel, diagnostics, and graph artifact import/export.

plugins.name: dsh-purge

description.zh: 独立维护的 dsh-purge 社区分支，提供宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、独立的更新检查与安装控制，以及本机备份回滚。
description.en: Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to $redteam_vps_host:9100

plugins.name: dsh-find-plugin

description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。
description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: MCP连接器：DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理面板；通过持续更新的超百个 MCP连接器目录接入 MCP Server，统一连接管理与授权配置、跨连接搜索工具并完成连接排障；可按连接/服务/发现状态筛选，查看易读参数、最后成功缓存时间和诊断，并逐连接重新发现工具；支持 OAuth 2.0 PKCE、API Key、stdio/HTTP 和 mcpServers JSON 导入；由企查查/QCC 团队维护。
description.en: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP manager with one panel to connect servers, configure authorization, search tools across connections, and troubleshoot failures. Browse a continuously updated catalog of over one hundred connectors; filter by connection/server/status, inspect readable parameters and the last successful cache time, and rediscover tools. Supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, stdio/HTTP, and mcpServers JSON import. Maintained by Qichacha/QCC.

plugins.name: dsh-claude-style

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。
description.en: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。
description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.

description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。
description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.

description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。
description.en: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.

description.zh: 通过 Android App 或手机浏览器访问 DeepSeek Harness，支持安全局域网连接、远程访问、持久设备配对和可自定义移动界面。
description.en: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.

description.zh: 多机远程工作区：管理多台 SSH 主机，在原生「添加工作区」流程里选本机系统文件夹或远程目录，把远程工作区镜像成真实本地文件夹并用 rw_* 工具操作。选择器是居中弹窗，默认落在本机页签，远程路径自动预填 `/` 并逐级自动补全目录。
description.en: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools. The picker is a centered modal that opens on the local tab and auto-fills `/` for remote paths, live-completing each directory level.

description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。
description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit

description.zh: 让纯文本模型处理视觉任务：粘贴图片后自动切换到 Vision Toolkit 变体，支持图片问答、多图比较、长截图 OCR、截图还原前端 UI、元素定位与像素对比。默认无需 API Key——图片经作者自建的免费服务处理，每台机器每天 100 张；也可改为指向自己的服务商。
description.en: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前跑「会话格式契约预检」（把不兼容的插件与 agent 预设扫出来先适配）、升级失败自动回滚、把拖垮过启动的插件自动隔离；另有环境指纹与公开契约规则库持续守门。内置多源插件市场只作发现层。
description.en: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.

description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。
description.en: Installs a dedicated AI novel-writing preset and workbench: revisioned local project assets, a compact side drawer, and native approval-gated single-file changes.

description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。
description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.

description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目，空闲时自动巩固记忆（autoDream），冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决，全程可回放审计。记忆落在本机：SQLite 存储配可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像；附带四路召回（关键词、向量、BM25、实体图谱）与交互式记忆库面板，另有 10 个模型工具、MCP 服务端、外部 API 与 CLI。摘要与巩固走你已配置的宿主模型；把嵌入换成本地模型后，语义检索可完全离线运行。
description.en: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.

description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材导出为可编辑副本。原生几何检查、不可变历史和审批闸门帮助保留已有作品。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 并保留旧宿主入口，提供 19 个建模、评审与交付工具。

Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Native geometry inspections, immutable revisions and an approval gate help preserve existing work. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and the legacy host, with 19 tools for modeling, review and delivery.

description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。
description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.

description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。
description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats

description.zh: 多供应商用量看板：按供应商/模型统计 Token 与日期下钻，统一展示账户余额，并追踪 OpenCode Go / Z.ai 订阅额度。
description.en: Multi-provider usage dashboard with provider/model token breakdowns, calendar drill-downs, account balances, and OpenCode Go / Z.ai subscription quota tracking.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 面向 DSH 的会话管家：浏览并批量清理官方会话归档集合，并对会话做四门体检（日志完整性 / 投影缓存 / 无损 JSON / 冷读），最终给出可逆、先备份的处方。不改写会话日志。
description.en: Session Steward for DSH: browse and bulk-prune the official session archive set, and run a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Never rewrites session logs.

description.zh: 通知提醒 / 消息提醒 / 消息通知 / 桌面通知弹窗 / 桌面提醒 / 弹窗通知、弹窗提醒 / 任务提醒、任务完成提醒 / 后台提醒、回复完成提醒 / 审批提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或任务、回复跑完时，弹出系统通知（可操作提醒、审批通知、完成通知）与提示音，并标记标签页标题；这是一款 DSH 通知提醒插件、DSH 提醒插件、消息通知插件，设置页可开关提醒、调音量、切换中英文通知语言。
description.en: Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.

description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。
description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.

description.zh: 酒馆管理面板：多角色卡、多世界书、多预设与会话级隔离，记忆总结、角色关系网、剧情选项一键发送，另有 NSFW 模式。完整效果需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-engine 与 dsh-muv-table，用于渲染状态栏、剧情选项与变量表格。
description.en: Tavern management panel for DeepSeek Harness: character cards, worldbooks and presets with per-session isolation, memory summaries, a character relationship web, one-click plot options and an NSFW mode. The full experience also needs the companion plugins dsh-muv-engine and dsh-muv-table, which render the status bar, the plot options and the variable tables.

description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。
description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。
description.en: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.

plugins.name: huaweicloud-devkit

description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。
description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工作台插件：收集自建项目与挂载的插件条目，支持改名、图标、排序、显示隐藏、项目与会话绑定和项目文件柜；内置自研分栏工作区引擎，窗格可拖拽分割、标签页管理，带资源管理器、终端、浏览器、动画与自定义窗口；项目内 agent 写完 widget-result.json 后，产物会自动挂载进对应窗口。
description.en: Workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: collects your own projects and mounted plugin entries with rename, icon, sort, show/hide, project-to-session binding and a per-project file cabinet, adds a split-pane workspace engine with draggable panes, tabbed windows and built-in Explorer, terminal, browser, animation and custom panes, and auto-mounts an agent output into the matching window when it writes widget-result.json.

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。
description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。
description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.

plugins.name: dsh-model-router

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。
description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: MCP 连接器（stdio / streamable-http）的受治理注册表：四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers JSON 导入对畸形 args 大声报错、输出边界全程脱敏、agent 桥接返回诚实 review 而非伪装放行，配 /mcp-reg 操作台与设置页。
description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.

description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。
description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.

plugins.name: dsh-research-report

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。
description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to doi.org

description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。
description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).

description.zh: 面向授权安全研究的 DSH 合集：九个工作模式（redteam 总控、渗透测试、代码审计、二进制分析、攻防评估、免杀对抗、应急溯源、云安全攻防、CTF 解题）与十五个运行时插件，设置页管理台支持一键部署、安装、更新与卸载。
description.en: Authorized-security DSH collection: nine work modes (redteam coordinator, pentest, code audit, binary analysis, attack-defense, AV evasion, incident response, cloud security, CTF solving) and fifteen runtime plugins, managed from a settings page with one-click deploy, install, update and uninstall.

description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。
description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中管理技能与 MCP 服务器：技能卡片热启停、工作区作用域、分组、批量迁移与拖拽导入，以及 stdio/HTTP MCP 增删改查、连接测试、密钥脱敏，并附带统一 dsh-panel 命令行。
description.en: Manages DSH skills and MCP servers from the web settings: skill cards with hot enable/disable, workspace scopes, groups, batch migration and drag-and-drop import, plus stdio/HTTP MCP CRUD with connection tests, secret redaction and the unified dsh-panel CLI.

description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。
description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.

plugins.name: dsh-composer-ux

description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。快捷指令存在全局文件 ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json 里，与会话、项目无关。
description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-zotero

description.zh: 面向 Agent 研究工作流的 Zotero 插件：搜索文献、查看元数据与笔记、提取与问题相关的证据段落、打开原文 PDF、生成引用与参考文献表。
description.en: Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to zotero.org

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：对主程序与每个已装插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅按系统语言（中/英）列出可更新项；一键更新——主程序自动备份、完整性校验、失败回滚，插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包；更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。
description.en: Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.

description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。
description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。
description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.

description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入，并预演 dsh-memory-protocol v1——适配器注册表与可分发的一致性套件。
description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.

description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。
description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.

description.zh: 通过 WebSocket V2 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Avernet Bot 协作网络，支持自动注册、Agent 会话隔离、工具调用事件和多 Bot 路由工具。
description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and multi-bot routing tools.

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-usage

description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。
description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中枢：基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表浏览、搜索、启停、查看、诊断并新建本地技能，附技能市场：来源快照跟踪、一键全量更新。
description.en: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, inspect, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, plus a skill market with tracked source sync and one-click update-all.

description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。
description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.

plugins.name: dsh-engram

description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。
description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 邮件工具插件：含 email_watch 增量新邮件检查、email_mark（已读/未读/星标/移动文件夹）与 email_reply（回复/回复全部/转发，自动线程头+引文）的十工具，Web 设置页与鲸鱼娘递信新邮件弹窗，since/until 日期范围过滤，内置 QQ/163/126/新浪/阿里/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud 预设，多账号、连接复用与发信审批门；Outlook OAuth2 设备码登录开箱即用（内置社区客户端，账号仍可填自己的 clientId 覆盖）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。
description.en: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
